features.name: Proposing an Event
features.description: To allow coordinators/heads of various clubs to propose the organization of events. [cite: 160] This is handled by Club Coordinators/Heads. [cite: 159]

functional_requirements.text: While applying for the same, they should be permitted to edit the event details and registration requirements. [cite: 12]

features.name: Registering for Events
features.description: To allow users to register for upcoming events. [cite: 114] This involves student actors. [cite: 112]

functional_requirements.text: If not logged in, user is prompted to log in. [cite: 127] After the event's approval, it should be added to the platform for registration by the student body. [cite: 18]

contracts.stimulus: The user attempts to edit event details and registration requirements while applying for an event
contracts.response: The system allows the user to modify the event details and registration requirements
contracts.postcondition: The modified event details and registration requirements are updated in the system

contracts.stimulus: User attempts to register for an event without being authenticated
contracts.precondition: User is not currently logged into the system
contracts.response: System prompts the user to log in before proceeding with event registration
contracts.postcondition: The user is redirected to the login interface and must successfully authenticate before they can continue with the registration process
